title: A star arriving from intergalactic space
statement: Exhibit a Gaia DR3 star that is unbound from the Milky Way and falling inward: with its Gaia DR3 astrometry, a stated distance and a published radial velocity, at least 99.7% of error samples have Galactocentric speed above the escape speed of MWPotential2014 with the halo scaled by 1.5 (597 km/s at the Sun) and Galactocentric radial velocity below zero.
witness_format: JSON object: source_id (Gaia DR3), ra_deg, dec_deg, pmra_mas_yr, pmra_error_mas_yr, pmdec_mas_yr, pmdec_error_mas_yr, rv_km_s, rv_error_km_s, rv_source, and either parallax_mas + parallax_error_mas (S/N >= 5) or distance_kpc + distance_error_kpc + distance_source
